candidates.description: MiR-34a is underexpressed in CD44-positive LAPC4 prostate cancer stem cells relative to CD44-negative cells.

candidates.description: Forced miR-34a expression inhibits tumor regeneration and reduces tumor growth of LAPC4 prostate cancer cells in xenograft mice.

candidates.original_title: The microRNA miR-34a inhibits prostate cancer stem cells and metastasis by directly repressing CD44
candidates.description: MiR-34a expression is increased in residual prostate cancer xenograft tumors after miR-34a expression is induced in the tumor cells.
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment was described in Protocol 6 in the Registered Report (Li et al., 2015) and is conceptually similar to what was reported in Supplemental Figure 4A,B of Liu et al. (2011).
candidates.notes: MiR-34a was not detectable in tumors derived from miR-34a-transduced LAPC4 cells, but the authors note that miR-34a overexpression was not confirmed in vivo and therefore the result is not interpretable as a clear test of tumor suppression. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: The microRNA miR-34a inhibits prostate cancer stem cells and metastasis by directly repressing CD44
candidates.description: CD44 expression is inversely correlated with miR-34a expression in prostate cancer tumors.
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment was described in Protocol 5 in the Registered Report (Li et al., 2015) and is conceptually similar to what was reported in Figure 4A of Liu et al. (2011), which used DU145 cells transduced with a retroviral vector encoding miR-34a.
candidates.notes: CD44 expression did not differ between groups, but interpretation is limited because miR-34a was not detectable in the miR-34a-transduced tumors. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
